gitCommit.subject: Ops: verify-production skips every 404.html, not only the top-level one
gitCommit.body:
Ops: verify-production skips every 404.html, not only the top-level one

The localized and in-app not-found files (fr/404.html, ar/404.html,
in-app/404.html, …) are the host's answers to unknown addresses: they carry
no canonical by design (D194). The page check read them as pages and asked
for a canonical; it now leaves them to verify-not-found, as it already did
for the root 404.html.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
